units.source_text: 中国《曲礼》云：“男子二十，冠而字。”

en.t: The Chinese Book of Rites says, "When a man reaches twenty, he receives the cap and takes a courtesy name."

units.source_text: 大学生入学时，依照中国儒家习惯，每人取个字号。

en.t: When university students entered school, each one took a courtesy name according to the Chinese Confucian custom.

units.source_text: 当时办法是：从姓上取一个字，另外再找一个字。

en.t: The method at the time was to take one character from the family name and then choose another character as well.

units.source_text: 如本书中数次讲到的菅原道真，字号菅三。

en.t: For example, Sugawara no Michizane, mentioned several times in this book, had the courtesy name Kansan.

units.source_text: 又如：纪长谷雄，字号纪宽；文屋康秀，字号文琳。

en.t: Another example is Ki no Haseo, whose courtesy name was Kikan; Fun'ya no Yasuhide had the courtesy name Bunrin.
